question.zh: 怎样从显微观察，走到一个会被修正的学说？
question.en: How do observations build—and revise—a theory?

lead.zh: 把木栓、活组织与分裂证据分开看，追问每一种观察支持哪一步解释。
lead.en: Separate cork, living tissues and division evidence, and ask what each observation supports.

principle.zh: 跨材料比较支持共同的细胞基础；追踪已有细胞的分裂，才能检验新细胞的来源解释。
principle.en: Comparing tissues supports cellular unity; tracing division tests explanations of cell origins.

question.zh: 两张照片里细胞数增加了，能否直接断言这些新细胞怎样产生？
question.en: Two photographs show more cells. Do they establish where the new cells came from?

explanation.zh: 不能。先确认同一组织和同一细胞的连续变化，排除视野或样本改变；看到已有细胞分隔成子细胞，才提供来源连续性的证据。
explanation.en: No. First establish the same tissue and tracked cells, excluding changes of sample or field. Observed division provides evidence of lineage continuity.

question.zh: 高倍下找不到目标，是它消失了吗？
question.en: Did the target vanish under high power?

lead.zh: 跟住同一个目标，比较视野、比例尺与可辨认的结构，解释为什么要先找到它。
lead.en: Follow one target through changes of field, scale and visible detail to explain why locating it matters.

principle.zh: 同一标本被视野截取；倍率、实物尺寸和可分辨细节必须分别判断。
principle.en: A field samples part of a specimen; magnification, physical size and resolved detail are different quantities.

question.zh: 目标离中心 480 μm，视场数 18 mm；10× 换 40× 后还能看到它吗？只放大旧照片能找回新细节吗？
question.en: A target is 480 μm from center with field number 18 mm. Will a 10× to 40× switch retain it? Can enlarging the old image recover new detail?

explanation.zh: 10× 时半径 900 μm，40× 时只有 225 μm，目标会离开高倍视野。先居中可保留它；放大同一旧图像只改变显示大小，不能新增原先未记录的细节。
explanation.en: The radii are 900 μm and 225 μm, so it leaves the high-power field. Centering retains it. Resizing the same image adds no unrecorded specimen detail.

question.zh: 叶绿体在移动，怎样知道不是整张装片在移动？
question.en: How do you distinguish chloroplast motion from slide drift?

lead.zh: 留下细胞壁这个参照，区分装片漂移与叶绿体相对位置的变化。
lead.en: Keep a wall landmark as a reference to distinguish slide drift from relative chloroplast movement.

principle.zh: 用固定结构作参照，检查同一标志的相对位移；黑藻观察借叶绿体显示细胞质流动。
principle.en: Track the same marker relative to a structural reference; Hydrilla chloroplasts reveal classroom cytoplasmic streaming.

question.zh: 细胞壁和叶绿体都向右移动，什么证据仍可支持细胞内运动？
question.en: Both wall and chloroplast move to the right. What could still support internal motion?

explanation.zh: 扣除细胞壁的共同位移后，叶绿体相对壁的位置仍改变。若相对位置不变，仅凭整体漂移不能得出流动结论。
explanation.en: Subtract the wall's displacement. A remaining chloroplast displacement supports internal motion; unchanged relative position cannot establish streaming from drift alone.

cues.title: 木栓小室说明了什么？
cues.titleEn: What do cork chambers tell us?
cues.caption: 先看隔壁和空腔，别把一张图当成整个学说。
cues.captionEn: Walls and cavities are evidence, not a whole theory.
cues.zh: 木栓里这些小室，足以说明所有生物的结构吗？先看留下的证据：一道道隔壁，围住了空腔。胡克在薄木栓片里看到的，主要是死细胞留下的细胞壁。这幅观察并没有告诉我们活细胞怎样工作，更没有显示新细胞从哪里来。要走向细胞学说，还得比较更多材料。
cues.en: Do these cork chambers tell us how all organisms are built? Look at the evidence: partitions enclose empty spaces. Hooke mainly saw walls left by dead cork cells. This observation does not show how living cells work, or where new cells come from. A broader theory needs comparisons with more material.

cues.title: 共同结构，新的来源解释
cues.caption: 比较支持共同基础；分裂证据修正细胞来源。
cues.captionEn: Comparison supports unity; division evidence revises cell origins.
cues.zh: 换成活的植物组织和动物上皮。形状不同，仍能辨认一个个细胞；多种材料的比较支持共同的细胞基础。但共同结构，不等于已经解释了细胞来源。曾有人认为新细胞像结晶一样形成。现在追踪一个已有细胞：这里略去核分裂，只看新隔壁逐渐把原来的空间分成两部分。这样的分裂观察，推动了细胞来源解释的修正。再看到组织生长，你会去找已有细胞的分裂，而不是只凭两张静态图片猜新细胞怎样出现。
cues.en: Compare living plant tissue with animal epithelium. Their shapes differ, yet individual cells remain recognizable. Many such comparisons supported a common cellular basis. But shared structure does not explain cell origins. One former idea pictured cells forming like crystals. Now follow an existing cell. Nuclear division is omitted here: a new partition divides its original space. Observations of division helped correct the explanation of new cell formation. When a tissue grows, follow existing cells through division; two unrelated still images cannot establish their lineage.

cues.title: 目标真的消失了吗？
cues.caption: 同一个目标还在，变小的是视野。
cues.captionEn: The target remains; the field becomes smaller.
cues.zh: 盯住带环的这一个细胞。低倍视野里能看见它，换到高倍，它却不见了。先别说细胞消失：在同一标本上，高倍只看见更小的一圈。目标原来的位置落在圈外。回到低倍，把它移到中央，再换高倍，同一个标记就留住了。变化的是我们能看见的范围，不是细胞凭空出现或消失。
cues.en: Follow the ringed cell. It is visible at low power, but disappears at high power. Has the cell vanished? On the same specimen, high power shows a smaller circle, and the target lies outside it. Return to low power, center the target, and switch again. The same marker remains. The visible region changed; the cell did not appear or disappear.

cues.title: 放大后，哪些推断成立？
cues.titleEn: What can a larger image establish?
cues.caption: 像变大，不等于细胞变大，也不保证新增细节。
cues.captionEn: A larger image is not a larger cell or guaranteed new detail.
cues.zh: 同一个细胞在高倍下占据更多画面，比例尺也一起变了。这里物镜从十倍到四十倍，视野直径变成四分之一，细胞尺寸没有改变。再比较叶细胞和动物上皮：绿色小体、形状和外壁可以不同，共同的细胞结构并不要求样样相同。最后，把同一幅模糊图像继续放大，原来分不开的细节并不会自动分开。所以，看不清的地方，不能直接说没有结构。
cues.en: The same cell fills more of the high-power image, and the scale bar changes with it. Here, a forty-times objective gives one quarter of the field diameter of a ten-times objective; the cell itself has not grown. Leaf cells and animal epithelium differ in shape and visible structures, yet share cellular organization. Now enlarge the same blurred image. Enlargement alone cannot recover missing detail. An unclear image is not evidence that a structure is absent.

cues.title: 绿色小体在哪里？
cues.caption: 叶绿体在细胞质中，中央液泡留下另一片空间。
cues.captionEn: Chloroplasts occupy cytoplasm around the central vacuole.
cues.zh: 选定一个叶细胞。绿色小体是叶绿体，中央淡色区域表示液泡。这个结构近景把不易看清的边界标出来：叶绿体在液泡周围的细胞质里，不在液泡里面。留下带环的叶绿体和同一处细胞壁，接下来比较它们的位置。这是解释图，不是新的显微照片。
cues.en: Choose one leaf cell. The green bodies are chloroplasts; the pale central region represents the vacuole. This explanatory overlay clarifies the boundaries. Chloroplasts occupy cytoplasm around the vacuole, not its interior. Keep the ringed chloroplast and a wall landmark for comparison. This close-up does not imply improved optical resolution.

cues.title: 整片在动，还是细胞里面在动？
cues.titleEn: Is the slide moving, or the cell interior?
cues.caption: 相对细胞壁的位置变化，揭示细胞内的运动。
cues.captionEn: Motion relative to the wall reveals movement inside the cell.
cues.zh: 叶绿体在画面里移动，细胞壁也跟着移动，这可能只是整张装片在漂移。现在固定同一处细胞壁作参照。带环的叶绿体沿周边改变位置，中央液泡仍在原处。这样的相对运动，支持这份黑藻材料中细胞质流动的观察。如果整张装片同时漂移，先扣掉细胞壁的共同位移，再判断内部有没有运动。
cues.en: A moving chloroplast can mislead us if the wall moves with it: the whole slide may be drifting. Now hold the same wall landmark fixed. The ringed chloroplast changes position around the periphery while the vacuole stays put. This relative motion supports the Hydrilla streaming observation. If both move across the screen, subtract the wall's displacement. What remains reveals movement inside the cell.
